title: Family
label: ch:ka-family
canDo: I can name close family, refer to he, she, it or they, say who works, mark his, her or their, and make a familiar non-human noun plural.

payoff.summary: Name the family set, distinguish human from non-human third person, say who works, form his/her/their, and make ಹೆಸರು and ಬಣ್ಣ plural with -ಗಳು.
